independent_progress_exceptions.reason: PSRAM fast-upload status waits do not service the mesh hook. A complete upload batch is already buffered; adapter TRANSFER supplies data without CPU or mesh progress. Round-robin arbitration serves pending uploads. Renderer texture reuse first uses the hooked GPU finish. No queued-job or legacy-lease dependency occurs in this bus-only completion wait.

Accepted legacy raw LOAD polling remains repair-only; its reserved engine/PSRAM transaction progresses without an async job. Generic yield inside context-write/START/result-registration is forbidden by load_alias_transaction. Source upload and prior CPU submission happen before acquire.
Inherited MTF2, QGF1 and BIM2 blocking helpers are capability-inactive on AJ02; the priority legacy branch explicitly skips prior QGF/BIM waits.

host_overhead_review: A retained lease caches quiescence only after checking real completed==submitted. Every new async submit releases first; fresh grants/releases clear the memo. Consumer reset preserves matching legacy raw ownership and cancels queued jobs, so it cannot introduce a blocked dependency.

Parallel task source offsets bind the exact immutable topology slot, vertex pointer, count/command shape and actual pool generation. Every real recycle clears the table, including generation wrap, and slot initialization invalidates the corresponding key.

Hint/dead-suffix cache rejection changes routing only. Exact transform/material acceptance and repair remain authoritative. Full context writes initialize every field and retain one42-word reservation/commit.
ordering_findings: Epoch-checked completed_sequence==submitted_sequence permits retaining an idle legacy lease: ordinary commands still forward and no unfinished async job can be blocked.

Otherwise a progress wait materializes canonical rows without emitting GPU commands, then releases the lease before repair/drain polling. The recursion guard prevents duplicate copy/release during service re-entry.
First ordinary canonical materialization releases immediately when all lazy slots are copied and unfinished jobs exist; survivor materialization preserves unrelated canonical/fog rows.
Source pool recycle waits the real completed sequence; an early priority grant is never treated as source completion.
One 42-word reservation/commit contains full CONTEXT28 then JOB11. No wait can split the context ownership bundle; legacy context is refreshed after fresh acquisition.
Reset retains only a matching granted ticket/raw bank, invalidates async sequence epoch, and traps on a contradictory legacy ownership record.

reviewed_actual_C_tests.note: Existing frozen actual-C ASan/UBSan suite covers masks, partial overwrites, delayed completion, recursion, ownership/reset, priority grant before completion and atomic context packets; not rerun or represented as RTL timing.
